description: Single radar/spider chart in one shared polar space. Central, overlaid polygonal shapes span the full 360° with varying radii. Light gray grid rings and spokes exist but are ignored as non-data decorations.

components.description: Filled polygonal areas: two semi‑transparent closed shapes connecting values around all angular axes; overlap occurs near the center and mid-radii.

primary.explanation: Two overlaid radar areas (two series) drawn in the same polar space.

secondary.explanation: Each area connects 7 categorical axes around the circle.
